messages.content: Create a cohesive folded 5x7 greeting-card theme, layout, and copy plan. Return only JSON with exactly four panels: front, inside-left, inside-right, back. Use approved memories only, avoid private claims, and make the card feel finished rather than terse. Each panel needs purposeful copy, art_direction layout notes, and a literal one-panel image_prompt. The app overlays exact typography, so image prompts reserve text-safe space instead of asking the image model to render final words.

{
  "task": "Generate a cohesive folded 5x7 greeting card theme, layout, panel copy, and literal image-generation prompts as JSON only.",
  "required_schema": {
    "theme_guide": {
      "theme_title": "string",
      "palette": [
        "string"
      ],
      "motifs": [
        "string"
      ],
      "border_style": "string",
      "front_back_pairing": "string",
      "interior_pairing": "string"
    },
    "panels": [
      {
        "id": "front",
        "headline": "string",
        "body": "string",
        "art_direction": "string",
        "image_prompt": "string",
        "image_negative_prompt": "string"
      },
      {
        "id": "inside-left",
        "headline": "string",
        "body": "string",
        "art_direction": "string",
        "image_prompt": "string",
        "image_negative_prompt": "string"
      },
      {
        "id": "inside-right",
        "headline": "string",
        "body": "string",
        "art_direction": "string",
        "image_prompt": "string",
        "image_negative_prompt": "string"
      },
      {
        "id": "back",
        "headline": "string",
        "body": "string",
        "art_direction": "string",
        "image_prompt": "string",
        "image_negative_prompt": "string"
      }
    ],
    "memory_citations": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "section_order": [
    "Choose one cohesive theme_guide from the occasion, personal_note, style, and approved memory_notes before writing panels.",
    "Write the panel copy so the card has an emotional arc from cover to interior to back.",
    "Write art_direction as layout notes for app-rendered typography and print-safe artwork.",
    "Write each image_prompt as a separate one-panel visual request for the image provider."
  ],
  "copy_requirements": [
    "Exactly four panels.",
    "Use each panel id exactly once in this order: front, inside-left, inside-right, back.",
    "Use only provided memory_notes.",
    "No order/payment claims.",
    "Never invent facts, quotes, religious claims, medical claims, sender history, or recipient traits that are not in the input.",
    "Do not produce generic one-line cards unless the input is extremely thin.",
    "Write final card copy only. Never write meta-copy about the requested tone, style, design language, prompt, theme instructions, CustomCard requirements, or what the card should feel like.",
    "Do not use filler such as 'A card made with care', 'For this moment', 'I wanted this card to feel like...', 'The heart of it is simple...', or '[occasion] with a [tone] feeling'.",
    "When memory_notes are provided, transform them into natural human card language instead of restating them as approved details.",
    "front headline <= 90 characters and body <= 160 characters; use the body only as a subtitle or short dedication.",
    "inside-left body should be 120-320 characters and feel like an opening note, quote, blessing, or scene-setting message.",
    "inside-right body should be 180-420 characters and carry the main personal message plus a natural sign-off when appropriate.",
    "back body <= 160 characters and should feel quiet, polished, and optional.",
    "All body text must fit a 5x7 card panel with generous margins."
  ],
  "layout_requirements": [
    "theme_guide is binding, but reuse motifs with restraint: a panel should have one dominant composition idea, not a scattered wallpaper of every motif.",
    "art_direction must name the panel's composition archetype, layout purpose, typography area, safe-margin plan, palette, border or ornament strategy, and relationship to its matching panel.",
    "front and back should visually match each other; the front carries the strongest hero idea and the back repeats a small quiet echo.",
    "inside-left and inside-right should visually match each other and feel like the opened interior spread.",
    "inside-left and inside-right must be border-first stationery designs with a calm blank/low-contrast center reserved for app-rendered text.",
    "Interior panels should usually be lighter, warmer, and more paper-like than the front/back covers; avoid using the same dark cover field on all four panels.",
    "Interior art must keep motifs on edges, corners, borders, or low-density background texture; do not fill the message area with busy all-over decoration.",
    "Never rely on a large opaque caption plaque, text box, label, banner, or card-within-card; text-safe space means natural negative space in the artwork.",
    "Prefer one of these composition archetypes per panel: cinematic single-object cover, sparse line-art cover, ornate border-first note sheet, lower-corner object cluster, or mostly blank back mark.",
    "Do not use all-over repeating motif patterns unless the user explicitly requests wallpaper, wrapping paper, or dense pattern.",
    "Use the requested style/culture/aesthetic as design direction, but keep sensitive cultural or religious text exact and conservative."
  ],
  "image_prompt_requirements": [
    "image_prompt is the exact prompt the image model will receive for that panel.",
    "image_prompt must describe one separate portrait 5x7 panel, not the whole four-panel set.",
    "image_prompt must be a concrete visual composition, not a restatement of form fields.",
    "image_prompt must not include labels such as Recipient, Relationship, Occasion, Tone, Style, Language context, Panel headline, Panel body, or Art direction.",
    "Do not ask the image model to render the headline or body. The app overlays typography after generation.",
    "Reserve clean text-safe space for the app overlay where the panel copy belongs.",
    "Do not describe the app overlay as a recipient name, headline, body, quote, blessing, verse, poem, short message, personal message, or scene-setting message; say only clean text-safe area.",
    "Do not create a caption plaque, inner card rectangle, blank label, sticky note, banner, or text box; text-safe must be integrated negative space, paper field, or quiet blank center.",
    "image_prompt must stay visual: concrete motifs, palette, border/frame treatment, background texture, ornament density, composition archetype, and hierarchy only.",
    "For the front, explicitly choose one dominant hero composition or sparse line-art composition with a clean lower or central text-safe area.",
    "For inside-left and inside-right, explicitly include: border-first stationery layout, thin refined frame, quiet center, clean text-safe area, generous margins, light ivory/cream low-contrast interior, and sparse edge/corner or lower-edge motifs.",
    "For the back, explicitly include mostly negative space and one small coordinating lower mark or border echo.",
    "Use symbolic objects, patterns, backgrounds, flat 2D illustration, and print design details.",
    "Coordinate palette, border style, motifs, and spacing across all four image_prompt values.",
    "For each image_prompt include: premium 5x7 vertical flat print panel artwork, the panel role, specific visual motifs, palette, style, composition, full-bleed 2D digital illustration quality, no people/no hands, no physical mockup, and no logos/no watermark/no readable text."
  ],
  "safety_requirements": [
    "Do not include people, faces, bodies, hands, customer groups, shop owners, signatures, handwriting, or portraits unless the user explicitly asks for a portrait/photo.",
    "Do not describe a physical paper card, folded card, envelope, tabletop, desk scene, product photo, mockup, shadowed card, framed card, or any object photographed in a scene.",
    "Do not include words, letters, glyphs, calligraphy, handwriting, labels, signatures, fake text, pseudo text, or decorative script marks.",
    "image_negative_prompt is a concise comma-separated list of visual failure modes to avoid for that panel, and must include readable text, fake text, letters, people, face, portrait, hands, folded card mockup, physical card mockup, tabletop scene, product photo.",
    "Return JSON only, no markdown."
  ],
  "input": {
    "sender": "Northstar Dental Supply",
    "recipient": "Avery at BrightSmile Clinic",
    "relationship": "customer success team to clinic operations contact",
    "occasion": "one-year purchase anniversary and extended warranty renewal reminder",
    "tone": "professional, warm, trust-building, useful, not pushy",
    "style": "premium dental supply customer-success stationery, clean white, deep teal, soft metallic accent",
    "language": "English",
    "personal_note": "Thank Avery at BrightSmile Clinic for one year since purchase of their sterilizer system and gently remind them their extended warranty renewal window closes July 31. CTA: Scan the enclosed QR code or contact their account manager.",
    "memory_notes": [
      "BrightSmile Clinic purchased a sterilizer system one year ago.",
      "The extended warranty renewal window closes July 31.",
      "Leave a clean area for an app-rendered QR code and account-manager CTA."
    ]
  }
}

message.content:
We need to generate a cohesive folded 5x7 greeting card for a professional dental supply customer success occasion. The theme should be premium dental supply customer-success stationery, clean white, deep teal, soft metallic accent. The card is for a one-year purchase anniversary and extended warranty renewal reminder. The tone is professional, warm, trust-building, useful, not pushy. We have memory notes: BrightSmile Clinic purchased a sterilizer system one year ago, extended warranty renewal window closes July 31, leave clean area for QR code and account-manager CTA.

We need exactly four panels: front, inside-left, inside-right, back. Each panel has headline, body, art_direction, image_prompt, image_negative_prompt. Also a theme_guide and memory_citations.

We must follow all requirements: no people, no text in images, use only provided memories, no invented facts, etc. The card should feel finished, not terse. The front headline <=90 chars, body <=160. Inside-left body 120-320 chars, inside-right body 180-420 chars, back body <=160. The interior panels should be border-first stationery designs with calm blank center for text.

We need to create an emotional arc: front introduces the occasion, inside-left sets a warm professional tone, inside-right delivers the main message with CTA, back is a quiet echo.

Let's plan theme_guide:
- theme_title: "Sterilizer Anniversary & Warranty Reminder"
- palette: ["Deep Teal (#005C5E)", "Clean White (#FFFFFF)", "Soft Metallic Silver (#C0C0C0)", "Warm Ivory (#FDF5E6)"]
- motifs: ["Sterilizer silhouette (abstract line art)", "Diamond/gear cross symbol (reliability)", "Subtle crosshatch grid (precision)", "Small star/asterisk (celebration)"]
- border_style: "Thin double line border in deep teal with soft metallic corner accents on interior panels; front uses full-bleed deep teal with white negative space; back uses clean white with small teal motif."
- front_back_pairing: "Front: deep teal full-bleed with white negative space for headline and a central white silhouette of a sterilizer. Back: clean white with a small teal diamond motif in lower right corner."
- interior_pairing: "Inside-left and inside-right: warm ivory background, thin double line border in deep teal with metallic silver corner dots, clean center for text, with a subtle crosshatch pattern only in the border area."

Now panels:

Front:
- headline: "One Year Strong" (10 chars)
- body: "Thank you for trusting BrightSmile Clinic with Northstar Dental Supply." (72 chars, within 160)
- art_direction: "Full-bleed deep teal background. Central white negative space in a soft rounded rectangle shape for headline and body text. Above the text area, a white line-art silhouette of a sterilizer unit (simplified geometric shape). The composition is a single-object cover with hero motif. Text-safe area occupies lower 60% of panel, centered. No border on front; the teal acts as frame. Palette: deep teal, white, no metallic here to keep contrast high."
- image_prompt: "Premium 5x7 vertical flat print panel artwork for front cover of a professional dental supply greeting card. Full-bleed deep teal background (#005C5E). In the upper half, a clean white line-art silhouette of a modern sterilizer unit, simplified geometric shape, centered. Below the illustration, a large clean white negative space area occupying the lower 60% of the panel, reserved for app-overlaid text. The composition is minimal, with no other elements. Style: flat 2D digital illustration, vector-like, no gradients, no shadows. No people, no hands, no physical mockup, no logos, no readable text."
- image_negative_prompt: "readable text, fake text, letters, people, face, portrait, hands, folded card mockup, physical card mockup, tabletop scene, product photo, gradients, shadows, 3D, realistic, complex details, multiple objects, clutter"

Inside-left:
- headline: "" (maybe no headline, but we need a headline field. Could be empty string? But requirement says headline is string. We can use a short phrase like "A Note of Thanks" but that might be redundant. Better to use a small headline: "Thank You" or "Your Partnership". Let's use "Your Trust" (9 chars) as headline, but inside-left body should be 120-320 chars. We'll write a warm opening note.)
- body: "At Northstar Dental Supply, we believe in building lasting partnerships. Your commitment to quality patient care inspires us every day. Thank you for choosing our sterilizer system for BrightSmile Clinic." (180 chars, within 120-320)
- art_direction: "Border-first stationery design on warm ivory background. Thin double line border in deep teal, with small metallic silver dots at each corner. Inside the border, a subtle crosshatch pattern in very light teal only along the border edges (not in center). The center is completely clean, low-contrast, reserved for text. The layout is a classic note sheet. No motifs in the center. Text-safe area occupies the entire inner rectangle with generous margins (1.5 inches from each edge)."
- image_prompt: "Premium 5x7 vertical flat print panel artwork for inside-left panel of a professional dental supply greeting card. Background is warm ivory (#FDF5E6). A thin double line border in deep teal (#005C5E) runs 0.5 inches from each edge. At each of the four corners of the border, a small metallic silver dot (circle). The border area has a very subtle crosshatch pattern in light teal (opacity 10%) only within the border strip. The entire center of the panel is clean, blank, low-contrast, with no motifs, reserved for app-overlaid text. Style: flat 2D digital illustration, print stationery. No people, no hands, no physical mockup, no logos, no readable text."
- image_negative_prompt: "readable text, fake text, letters, people, face, portrait, hands, folded card mockup, physical card mockup, tabletop scene, product photo, heavy patterns, clutter, gradients, shadows, 3D, realistic"

Inside-right:
- headline: "" (Again, we can use a small headline like "Your Warranty" or "Next Steps". Let's use "Extended Coverage" (16 chars) but that might be too long. Better to use "Renewal Reminder" (15 chars) or just leave it as empty string? The schema says string, so we can put an empty string. But the instruction says 'headline' is a string, not required to be non-empty. However, for a cohesive card, a headline on inside-right might be good. Let's use "Your Warranty" (12 chars). But the body should carry the main message. We'll write a longer personal message.)
- body: "Your sterilizer system's extended warranty renewal window closes July 31. To ensure uninterrupted coverage, simply scan the QR code below or contact your account manager at [account-manager-email]. We're here to support you every step of the way. With appreciation, The Northstar Dental Supply Customer Success Team" (260 chars, within 180-420)
- art_direction: "Same border-first stationery design as inside-left for visual consistency. Warm ivory background, thin double line border in deep teal with metallic silver corner dots. Center is clean for text. At the bottom of the text-safe area, a reserved rectangular space for a QR code (app-rendered). The QR code area should be indicated by a subtle dashed outline in light teal, not a solid box. The rest of the center is blank. The composition matches inside-left."
- image_prompt: "Premium 5x7 vertical flat print panel artwork for inside-right panel of a professional dental supply greeting card. Background is warm ivory (#FDF5E6). A thin double line border in deep teal (#005C5E) runs 0.5 inches from each edge. At each of the four corners of the border, a small metallic silver dot (circle). The border area has a very subtle crosshatch pattern in light teal (opacity 10%) only within the border strip. In the lower portion of the clean center, a subtle dashed rectangle outline in light teal (opacity 30%) indicates a reserved area for a QR code (approx 1.5x1.5 inches). The rest of the center is completely blank, low-contrast, reserved for app-overlaid text. No other elements. Style: flat 2D digital illustration, print stationery. No people, no hands, no physical mockup, no logos, no readable text."
- image_negative_prompt: "readable text, fake text, letters, people, face, portrait, hands, folded card mockup, physical card mockup, tabletop scene, product photo, heavy patterns, clutter, gradients, shadows, 3D, realistic, solid box for QR code"

Back:
- headline: "" (or a small phrase like "Northstar Dental Supply" but that might be too long. Better to leave empty or use a short tagline. Let's use "Precision. Trust. Care." (22 chars) but that might be too much. The back body <=160 chars. We'll write a quiet closing.)
- body: "Thank you for being a valued partner. We look forward to many more years of excellence together." (85 chars)
- art_direction: "Clean white background with minimal design. A small deep teal diamond motif in the lower right corner, about 0.5 inches. No border. The rest is blank. The composition is a mostly blank back mark. Text-safe area is the entire panel with generous margins."
- image_prompt: "Premium 5x7 vertical flat print panel artwork for back panel of a professional dental supply greeting card. Background is clean white (#FFFFFF). In the lower right corner, a small deep teal (#005C5E) diamond shape (solid, about 0.5 inches tall). No other elements. The rest of
